# vocomatcher

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of vocomatcher is to assist with matching and deduplicating animal calls in microphone array based acoustic surveys.

This repo originally forked from https://github.com/jaytohe/ecostats-rshiny.git.

## R Version
The app has only been tested on R version 4.4.3 (2025-02-28).


## Installation

### Ordinary users

Install Vocomatcher from [this GitHub repository](https://github.com/iandurbach/ecostats-rshiny). Run the following commands once in R:

``` r
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github(
  "iandurbach/ecostats-rshiny",
  dependencies = TRUE,
  upgrade = "never",
  build_vignettes = TRUE
)
```

Then launch the app whenever you want to use it:

``` r
vocomatcher::run_app()
```

Open the installed user guide with:

``` r
vignette("vocomatcher", package = "vocomatcher")
```

The app opens in your web browser. Keep the R process running while using it. `build_vignettes = TRUE` installs the full illustrated user guide. `upgrade = "never"` prevents installation from unexpectedly upgrading unrelated packages; if R reports that an installed dependency is too old, update that package or repeat the installation with `upgrade = "ask"`.

### Developers

Clone the repository from a terminal:

``` bash
git clone https://github.com/iandurbach/ecostats-rshiny.git
cd ecostats-rshiny
```

Open R in the cloned repository, install the development tools once, then load the source and launch the app:

``` r
install.packages(c("pkgload", "devtools"))

pkgload::load_all(".")
vocomatcher::run_app()
```

After making source changes, run `pkgload::load_all(".")` again before relaunching the app.
